svg.title: From the car to its electrics
svg.desc: The battery is under a cover in the front luggage area. The starter and alternator are on the engine behind the seats; positive cables and body/engine earth connections bridge that distance. Follow starting power from the front battery to the rear starter, charging power from the alternator, a protected lamp branch, and the earth return. Driver requests and starting authorisation have a separate control role. Numbered parts: 1 Battery and cover; 2 Positive feed and distributor; 3 Protection and distribution; 4 Body and engine earth; 5 Starter and flywheel drive; 6 Alternator and belt drive; 7 Halogen and lower light unit; 8 Ignition and lighting controls. Explanatory separation, not a workshop sequence.
